dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse lighter-grey patches distributed irregularly on the left lateral-dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the primary slate grey baseline and lighter mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, high-contrast white focal points visible along the crest of the longitudinal dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, raised longitudinal dorsal ridge extending along the posterior central axis.
